comment: Grouped contracts — every sanctioned deep-import module carries a group justification. A module joining ungrouped fails the gate until placed deliberately (--record parks it in 'unclassified').

design-system-base.why: the facade's Box/Text ARE the themed wrappers — the design system + theming layer reaches the raw primitives and styling truth directly (re-routing would cycle through the facade)

escape-vocabulary.why: shared protocol constants — public escape vocabulary, no decision bodies

held-alt-release.why: the launcher-held alt-buffer one-shot — main.tsx's commander output writer must release the hold BEFORE any usage error prints and before any screen mounts; a pre-facade boot seam by design (the facade itself is not loaded yet on those paths)

width-oracle.why: the ONE width oracle and its pinned wrap dispatcher (prove-width-oracle-sot)

event-and-geometry-types.why: type vocabulary consumed app-wide (KeyboardEvent/InputEvent/selection geometry/instance + render types) plus the currentInputEventSeq read; dom and frame contribute only their DOMElement / FlickerReason types

session-truth.why: terminal capability + focus state — read-side truth the app consults directly

runtime-seams.why: deliberate cross-plane seams: live instance registries, the node cache, the flush-probe registry, and the instance/size contexts, the frame-trace ring (app land feeds keystroke resolutions + reads /trace), and the terminal notification ping writer (the switchboard's needs-you bell rings through the termio owner — a facade route would cycle)

package-scoped-components-and-hooks.why: module-level component/hook API the facade deliberately keeps package-scoped (single-purpose surfaces with few, named consumers); the hooks and components the facade also re-exports count here when a consumer reaches them by module path — the same API either way

lustre-recess-layer.why: the focused-layer backdrop: the policy owner (utils/cockpit/recessBackdrop) and the elevated-surface hosts (FullscreenLayout, mercury-ui CommandCenter) reach the compositor's recess store + color math directly; the recess is a COMPOSITOR law (post-compose styleId remap), so its registration/target seams live beside the cell grid by design

terminal-mode-ledger.why: the terminal-mode obligation ledger: arm-site owners (ink App raw-mode/cursor, AlternateScreen session trio, the /mouse live toggle, launcherAltHold imports) note acquisitions beside their byte writes, and gracefulShutdown's cleanup derives its EXACT close set from the open obligations (settle-exactly-once; no broad unconditional reset). The ledger is pure per-process state living beside the root owners it records — a facade re-route would put bookkeeping on the far side of the writes it must mirror.

transitional-seams.why: truncate.ts keeps a compiling alias for the format.ts barrel's wrapText re-export until the barrel drops it and the alias is removed, at which point 'wrap-text' leaves this set (a shrink never fails the gate). Nothing outside the barrel imports it.

viewport-floor.why: the ONE viewport-floor latch (80 × 22): the surface router freezes the size the REPL subtree sees from it, and the screen hosts outside the runtime judge the floor on the live size — one owner for the floor, read where the surfaces mount
